verified_claims: The exact squared norm of each continuum Dirac mode is (m^2 + |k_n|^2) times the squared spinor norm.
The maximal coefficient-space domain is exactly summability of the modal Dirac energies.
For coefficient l2 fields, that domain is equivalent to the inhomogeneous first-order Fourier condition.
The maximal free Dirac domain is independent of the mass parameter.
The exact squared norm of the coefficient-space operator image is the sum of the weighted modal energies.
The physical torus domain is the Fourier pullback of the maximal coefficient domain and has the same first-order characterization.
The physical torus partial operator intertwines exactly with the coefficient multiplier under the checked Fourier equivalence.
The physical torus Dirac operator is densely defined, symmetric, self-adjoint, and closed.
The exact physical-space operator energy equals the same weighted Fourier sum.
nonclaims: No identification of the checked continuum unitary group with the unbounded functional-calculus exponential is proved.
No Stone theorem or spectral theorem uniqueness statement is claimed.
No graph, norm-resolvent, or strong-resolvent convergence of lattice generators is proved.
No gauge-covariant or interacting unbounded Dirac Hamiltonian is constructed.
No dynamical gauge field, gravity, cosmology, or empirical prediction is claimed.
